title: A Quiet Street
text:
My neighborhood is small and quiet. There is a bakery on my street. The bread is hot and fresh. I buy bread there every day.

Across the street there is a library. Many children read books there on Saturday. My friend lives next to the library. We often meet at the park.

questions.text: What is on the writer's street?
When do many children read books at the library?
How does the writer probably feel about the bakery?
options: They do not know where it is

questions.text: What can we guess about the writer's friend?
options: The friend probably lives close to the writer
The friend works at the library
The friend lives in another country

vocabulary.definition: the area around the place where you live
a shop that sells bread and cakes
a place where you can borrow books

paragraph_translations: Мій район маленький і тихий. На моїй вулиці є пекарня. Хліб там гарячий і свіжий. Я купую там хліб щодня.
Через дорогу є бібліотека. У суботу там читає книжки багато дітей. Мій друг живе поруч із бібліотекою. Ми часто зустрічаємося в парку.
